verdict.rationale: Spline's docs describe code export (Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, react-three-fiber) and a Code API, but there is no evidence of a Figma-style 'Inspect' mode that lets a developer view measurements, styles, and per-layer CSS/iOS/Android snippets without an editor seat. Pricing mentions only 'Code & Self-hosted exports' and 'Team Library', not a viewer-only handoff mode.
